title: The Canon of the True Vector
summary: A canon of lines of force laid through space so each strike travels the straightest road and ends in a storm of lines.

title: Treatise of the Turning Axis
summary: A treatise on setting an axis through space and turning the foe or the field about it until both break.

title: Manual of Bound Knots
summary: A manual of tying knots into space itself so a foe is held fast and the knot may be drawn tight on a crowd.

title: The Thread-Walker's Canon
summary: A canon of drawing fine threads of space between two points and walking or casting force along them.

title: Reckoning of the Woven Weft
summary: A reckoning of weaving crosswise strands of space into nets shrouds and cutting blades.

title: The Chord Severance Canon
summary: A canon of drawing a chord across space between two points and cutting everything that lies along it.

title: Treatise of Torsion
summary: A treatise on twisting space about a foe's body until it wrings the limbs and tears the flesh from within.

title: Canon of Dilated Space
summary: A canon of swelling a volume of space so distance grows within it and blows lose their strength.

title: The Endless Loop Treatise
summary: A treatise on bending a stretch of space into a loop so that what enters it returns to where it began.

title: Manual of the Parallax Veil
summary: A manual on shifting the apparent place of the body so a foe strikes where the user only seems to stand.
